name: ampex-atr-warm-2bus
description: Warm, fuller mixdown color on the UADx Ampex ATR-102 — REPRO, 15 IPS (bigger head bump, fuller lows), Ampex 456, Cal +6, 1/2" tape, NAB (50 Hz bass shelf), transformer ON, subtle modeled wow&flutter + crosstalk for vibe. More drive than the master-glue preset — audible warmth + light tape compression.
intended_for: a stereo mix / 2-bus / fuller-sounding mixdown where you want obvious-but-musical tape warmth (the classic ATR mixdown). Color insert before mastering.
plugin_build: uaudio_*.vst3 (UADx native build — renders headless; the UAD *.component twin passes audio through unprocessed offline, do NOT use it)

target_signature.comment: measured dry -> processed on projects/drums-kit/mix/bus_70s_balanced.wav (peak-normed), +10 dB drive. centroid in [L] measure-spectrum units.

notes: 15 IPS = warmer/fuller than 30 IPS (bigger ~50-70 Hz head bump, more HF roll-off, more compression). NAB adds a 50 Hz bass shelf (CCIR is leaner/brighter).
+10 dB drive measured ~2.6 dB of tape compression (crest 25.0 -> 22.4) and slight darkening (centroid 4266 -> 3871). Back off if the top starts to spit (rising 3rd harmonic).
If the low end gets boomy (15-IPS head bump), pull repro_lf_eq down (default 9.7) or HPF post-tape — it's the bump, not saturation.
